hero.label: School project · ICT Engineering, ITSM
hero.title: Find the right company for your professional internship.
hero.description: Answer five questions about what you enjoy and the technologies you know. Nexus-TIC compares your profile with each company and shows how well you match, with their openings.
hero.time: Takes about 3 minutes · with or without voice
hero.step1d: Design, networks, security, data, apps… pick the activities that interest you.
hero.step2d: The ones you know or are learning: React, Python, Linux, Docker and more.
hero.step3d: Sorted by match, with their openings and a PDF summary for your advisor.
hero.sample: Companies are examples to show how it works.
